title: unified-rollouts-weighted-shadow-autorollback
author: Lucas Chen
body: Motivation: Add first-class support for weighted shadow traffic in the unified rollouts engine and automatic rollback triggers when composite metrics indicate regression. This enables teams to run weighted canary experiments with simultaneous shadow traffic probing while keeping a single, declarative rollout resource. Changes include a new WeightedShadowStage primitive, metric quorum evaluation for shadow probes, enhanced telemetry for matching metrics across primary/canary/shadow populations, safety guards to prevent noisy shadow signals from causing noisy rollbacks, and operator-level feature flags for gradual rollout of the capability. See linear tickets ENG-4321 and ENG-4400 for design notes. Summary of changes: 1) rollout controller: add WeightedShadowStage type, reconcile logic, and stage transitions; 2) autorollback engine: composite-metric evaluator extended to include shadow quorum and weighted delta thresholds; 3) observability: add per-stage histogram and ratio metrics, align metric labels for canary/primary/shadow; 4) e2e: add integration tests simulating weighted shadow scenarios and flapping signals; 5) docs and SDK: rollout schema update and SDK helpers for creating weighted shadow stages. Safety checklist: ensure metric alignment between populations, default conservative thresholds, and opt-in operator feature flag. High level impact: enables more realistic preflight probing of new models without exposing end-users to changes, improves rollback precision for shadow-driven regressions, and integrates with existing canary/AB workflows.
commits: Add WeightedShadowStage CRD and controller logic
Extend composite-metric evaluator to include shadow quorum
Add e2e tests for weighted shadow probing
Docs: rollout schema + examples for weighted shadow
review_comments: Priya Desai: Overall design looks good. Please add more unit tests around quorum edge cases.
Lucas Chen: Added additional unit tests and clarified quorum semantics in comments.
Owen Miller: Observability changes look fine but please ensure labels are backwards compatible.
Lucas Chen: Labels kept backwards compatible; added migration note in metrics_registry.go.
Marta Gonzalez: Can we gate the rollout with a feature flag so operators can opt-in?
Lucas Chen: Added operator feature flag 'enableWeightedShadow' with default=false; documented rollout.
merge_commit_message:
squash: unified rollouts: weighted shadow autorollback and observability

Implements WeightedShadowStage, shadow quorum evaluation, safety guards, and e2e tests. Fixes ENG-4321 and ENG-4400.
release_notes: Added WeightedShadowStage to unified rollouts allowing weighted shadow probing with automatic rollback triggers based on composite metrics. Feature is gated by operator flag 'enableWeightedShadow'. Includes observability updates and e2e tests.
notes: This PR was tested end-to-end on staging clusters with synthetic traffic generators. We ran a 48h canary where shadow traffic exposed a subtle latency regression in the candidate model; the autorollback triggered only after quorum was reached and secondary metrics breached conservative thresholds. Operator rollout plan recommends enabling feature flag in staging first, verifying metrics, then enabling in production for noncritical services.
changelog_entry: 2026-02-12: Added weighted shadow autorollback to unified rollouts (feature-flagged).
qa_notes: Manual QA steps provided in docs/rollouts/weighted_shadow.md. Run e2e-weighted-shadow job and validate metric labels and rollback behavior.
manual_steps: 1) Enable feature flag enableWeightedShadow in operator config. 2) Apply example rollout from docs/rollouts/weighted_shadow.md. 3) Start synthetic shadow traffic using tests/mock_metric_server.go. 4) Observe metrics and trigger failure scenarios to validate autorollback.
post_merge_actions: 1) Monitor rollout-controller.k8s.redwood rollouts for 24h. 2) Run canary smoke job against production for low traffic model. 3) Progressive enablement plan with runbook.
